# awscc_osis_pipeline_endpoint (Resource)

Creates a VPC endpoint for an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline, enabling private connectivity between your VPC and the pipeline.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline to create the endpoint for.
- `vpc_options` (Attributes) Configuration settings for the VPC endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc_options))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline endpoint.
- `endpoint_id` (String) The unique identifier of the pipeline endpoint.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `ingest_endpoint_url` (String) The URL used to ingest data to the pipeline through the VPC endpoint.
- `status` (String) The current status of the pipeline endpoint.
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC where the pipeline endpoint was created.

<a id="nestedatt--vpc_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vpc_options`

Optional:

- `security_group_ids` (List of String) A list of security group IDs that control network access to the pipeline endpoint.
- `subnet_ids` (List of String) A list of subnet IDs where the pipeline endpoint network interfaces are created.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_osis_pipeline_endpoint.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the pipeline endpoint

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_osis_pipeline_endpoint.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_osis_pipeline_endpoint.example "arn"
```
